notes.title: New build (0616a)
notes.content:
Hey Boodies & Boodettes, we're back with a small new playtest version thx to your feedback !

- We've added few rare bonuses in Survival
- In survival mode, if only one player dies, it's game over for everyone.
- We reduced the red smoke in Survival mode again.
- Panels have now their text centered.
- And we have spatialized sounds too!

We've also corrected a few bugs, including
* Zoom effect in tournament "hurry up"
* some minor corrections in the menus.

Thanks again in advance for your time and futur new feedback.

notes.title: New build (0507a)
notes.content:
Dear Boodies & Boodettes,

Here's a new version of the playtest!

We've fully bugged this version and added:

 Some statistics (so we can know which modes you play more)
 The last Survival level has been corrected but, hey, you'll never reach this level. 😉
 Better sounds for score in survival
 Added more bonuses in Paint mode
 Hurry up zoom has been corrected (but it's not finished yet)
 Random Classic levels are back, (instead of always the same one).
 Survival Menus slightly improved (Main and End/Score)

notes.title: New build (0425a)
notes.content:
Hi Boodies!

We've just published a new playtest build!
Here's what new or different:


 We've added ESC as a default key to go back in the menus
 The survival fog has been adjusted for the game to be clearer
 We've made correction in french texts
 We've added more logs in case of crash or error : if you encounter any crash during the playtest, please let us know. We will ask you to send us the .log files you'll find in your Windows personal folder + AppData\Roaming\Dstroy2 (AppData is an hidden directory) 


Thx very much for your feedback.

notes.title: Test
notes.content:
Hello

Welcome to the Dstroy 2 test branch!

This is a short test of the Event Posting feature.
It will allow us to announce to you when a new version is released, and its changes and content differences.

Thank you and see you soon.
